content: Saguhoem toenzepa adâkeze myakâwândy Deus kydamudo tytaumbyry egatuwâni modoram, tytanrugue aguely atay, eâenkymoem aguely atay, âpaunzedomo oday atay, enu oday nhugunehonly atay warâ. Akaemo pylâ myakâwândy Deus aguehobyry kurâ domodoram egatuin-ro warâ.
Xirâ ume, xypyry iwaguepa idyly iray olâ mâkâ imerylâ Deus kiuntudyze ato agueim. Tymery agâlâ myakâwândy Deus idânârâ nhugudyly. Idânârâ tiungutyby modo sodoem itoem tymeryam aguewânmy.

Deus eon-honru, iwâkuru, pymâem awyly warâ etolâ imery, Deus agâ âzekiba awylygue. Mâkâ imery itanru ton-honreingue idânârâ âdydo imeom eon-honwanâdybyem awyly. Mâkâlâ mawânkâ igueim, inakanhe aguitobyry xygakehoem, Deus xurâem tywykenryem kitoem. Igueypyem, kurâem itondybyem, Deus ton-honreim kuru eydâ atoam odopâmâ. Eahoru eynynâ ekadybyem awyly pymâ ekadodâ.
Deus imery tynrenseim kuru, ton-honreim warâ, anju domodo takaze kehoem

“Ymery” kewânmy Deus Jesusram. Awylygue kiuntuly Jesus, anju domodo takazeno kuru awyly. Deus imery tynrenseim kuru anju domodo takaze. Deus Imery kelygue tâzekeim imâsedo kuru, “anju” kelygue tâzekeim takaze.

content.text: “Ymery âmâ, unwâm urâ warâ;
kurâdoram ymery mawyly kâenehonly warâ” kepa,

content: tymeryam adâkehobyry ara, warâ iwenibyem awyly. Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ iwenibyem âdaunlo anjuam wakewâpyra:

content.text: “Nhunwym ise urâ; ymery ise mâkâ” kewâpyra;

content: Deus, tymery onro anaxi igonoseaji awyly ume,

content.text: “Idânârâ anju domodo ymery nhyrendyly ize wato” kewândymy.
“Urâ Deuslâ anju domodo xuguni.
Sapezenru ara, peto ara warâ kehoem eon-honromoem adyese urâ.
Iemaryem aitomoem urâlâ agueim”

content: warâ iwenibyem awyly Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ.

content.text: “ ‘Âdaunloenlâ nadainwâpyra ise pymâem mawyly.
Koendâ lelâ ise âynynonro modo mâendyly.
Kurâ domodo koendâ anhekyly tohogueze âmâ;
akaemo inakanhe kulâ anhekyly olâ mâen-hoguebyra âmâ.
Awylygue aunloenlâ pymâem mitoem ajiedâ.
ÂDeusry urâ.
Mohomaendoem ajiedâ,
ataen-hodo duay tynrenseim kehoem âwanu amânhedylygue
ewanumo takaze iwanu imâsedoem awylygue âduakely’ kewândymy”

content: Warâ lâpylâ myakâwândy iwenibyem awyly Jesus wâgâ aguehobyry:

content.text: “Âdy peba awyly ume, amygueduo akâwândy, onro, kau warâ mâungunehonly, Pymâ.
Imaryguelâ mâyngadyly waunlo ara.
Kau, onro warâ adainze;
âtâ tâjiwogonro adainly ara ise kau, onro warâ adainly,
Âmâ olâ ise âdaunloenlâ madaimpa.
Âtâ tâjiwogonro xugukely ara ise kau, onro warâ mâungukely.
Âmâ olâ ise âdaunloenlâ mâtugugueba”

content: warâ iwenibyem awyly Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ.
Jesus, anju domodo takaze kehoem awyly, tutuze kurâ, Deus mawânkâ, tymeryam adâkehobyry ara, eyanmo aguepa:

content.text: “Yahoru eynynâ ikagâ tynrenseim ekadodâ,
âduery modo eon-honru kainly ara,
âdydo ara kulâ âhuru iaxi kânhedylymo ara”

content: kewândymy Deus tymeryam; anju domodo ewyampa aguely; warâ iwenibyem awyly Deus itaumbyry awo wâgâ.
Anju domodo-ro? Anju domodoma tâenseim keba, Deus emaryem tâwaneim akaemo. Kurâ Jesusram âzemakeorim modo emawyadâze Deus ingonokyly.
